Index Only Scan using uq_participant_contest_user on public.contest_participants cp

trade_off: The maintained cells cost one extra locked row update inside every verdict transaction, and the standings_version counter serialises verdict commits for the same contest. In exchange the read path touches one small indexed table instead of re-deriving the whole contest per request. Judging throughput is bounded by sandbox start-up (tens of milliseconds at best), so paying a row lock per verdict is a good trade for a read that every participant polls.
